import re

def parse_expense_body(body):
    flight=None; accom=None; meals=None
    m=re.search(r'Flight\s*Expense\s*:\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+)', body, flags=re.I)
    if m: flight=int(m.group(1))
    m=re.search(r'Accommodation\s*Expense\s*:\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+)', body, flags=re.I)
    if m: accom=int(m.group(1))
    m=re.search(r'Meals\s*Expense\s*:\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+)', body, flags=re.I)
    if m: meals=int(m.group(1))
    return flight, accom, meals

    body=e.get('body','') or ''

    first=name.strip().split()[0] if name.strip() else sender_email.split('@')[0].split('.')[0]
